name: CVCT Cascade Light Sampling & Blending
definition: Samples a 3D light texture at two adjacent cascade levels and blends the results to provide smooth lighting transitions across voxel grid resolutions.
summary: CVCT Cascade Light Sampling & Blending samples multi-resolution 3D textures and interpolates between cascades based on distance to prevent aliasing and memory waste in real-time voxel cone tracing.
